Smart Scope Item

Help
Show explanations for these controls
The checkbox on the Smart Scope list controls whether this item applies. These settings control how a selected item is priced and where it appears on the customer proposal.
$
Pricing Treatment
Sets the Smart Scope default for applicable System Options. Customer Optional keeps the item outside the System Option price. Include in System Price bakes the amount into the System Option price. Individual System Options may override this default in Price Breakdown.
Proposal Placement
Controls where this item appears on the customer proposal. Installation Scope places the item with the included system scope. Enhancement Options and Warranty / Protection present it as a customer-facing option. Do Not Print hides the wording. Proposal placement never changes pricing.

Protection Price Resolution

This changes proposal display wording only. It does not change system pricing.

Voice Commands

SET / FILTER

Speaking a recognized value SETS that category. Repeating it keeps it selected.

"four ton"
"five ton straight cool"
"four ton two stage"
"heat pump"
"coastal"
"apartment coastal"
"any coastal"
"price under 9000"

REMOVE

REMOVE subtracts only the named values. Multiple values may be removed in one command.

"remove four ton"
"remove coastal"
"remove four ton coastal straight cool"
"remove price"

CLEAR

Clears selections completely.

"clear filters" Clears search filters only
"clear view" Clears sort + Top-N/Both Ends
"clear all" Clears filters + view concurrently

RESULT VIEW & COMBINED

Limit or sort the results.

"three cheapest"
"cheapest first"
"five most expensive"
"three cheapest and three most expensive"
"show both ends"
"three cheapest four ton"
